decisions: Criterion 5 — every numeric leaf of the /api/calculate payload is covered by exactly one entry in that payload's dispositions map, keyed by leaf path.
D-72 — serialize_leaf stays the only producer of a payload leaf and of that leaf's entry; this slice widens what goes through it, it does not add a second writer.
R-17/D-97 — landed against the committed coupled baseline plus this allowlist; the baseline is re-captured at the phase boundary, never here.
R-20 — the qualifying population is the same one P4-S9-dispositions enumerated, because the map is one leaf per captured combat receipt and this slice changes its contents rather than its location.

change.one_sentence: The dispositions map's keys become the paths the leaves actually live at, and every numeric leaf of the combat receipt gets an entry — the duration, each participant's stats, the utility receipt, the two objective republications and the nested support-on-hit rows included.
change.wire_shape: Unchanged. Every published number keeps its value and its position; what moves is the key set of the sibling map.

why_the_map_was_short.path_grammar: Survival rows were described at a synthetic 'participants.survival.<participant_id>.<leaf>' while the payload publishes them at 'participants[i].survival.<leaf>'. Every one of those entries named a path the payload does not have (99 ghosts in mandate_abyssal_curse_roster) while every row leaf it described was itself unnamed.
why_the_map_was_short.unwritten_blocks: duration, participants[i].stats.*, utility_outcomes.*, breakdown[i].utility_outcomes.*, objective.focus_survival.*, objective.focus_utility_outcomes.* and nested events[i].support_on_hit_magic[j].* were assigned into the payload rather than written through the block, so no serialize_leaf call ever saw them.

measured.pair_golden: zero diffs — the map is coupled-path output and golden enters through pipeline.run_fight (D-93).

oracle_pass.why: R-19 asks an independent investigator to adjudicate between an old and a new value. The ten occurrences this slice touches are the same absent_to_value block P4-S9-dispositions enumerated: the coupled baseline predates the map entirely, so there is no old value to adjudicate and no arithmetic to reproduce from cached wiki text. No published number moves — the difference set is the identical 142 paths, path for path, before and after.
oracle_pass.numeric_evidence: tests/test_payload_dispositions.py asserts the map's key set equals the payload's published quantities, both directions, over all five combat-carrying coupled scenarios against live runs — the non-golden numeric gate this slice cites (D-93).

landed_against.rule: R-17/R-32/D-97 — no baseline moves inside this commit
